description: List attorneys by name, firm, side and district, most cases first. get_attorney gives one attorney in full.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page; omit for the first page.

limit.description: Results per page, at most 50 (the default).

name.description: Part of the name, any case.

purpose.description: One sentence on what you are trying to find out. Logged to improve the dataset; never returned.

side.description: Only those with cases for this side, ranked by their cases on that side rather than by all their cases.

name: search_attorneys

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last.

cases.description: Every case the attorney appeared in, with any firm they have filed with.

casesByYear.description: Cases counted by the year they were filed.

defenseCases.description: Of cases, those on the defense side.

name.description: The name the Connecticut Judicial Branch registers for the juris number; null when it lists no attorney under it. The attorney's cases are counted either way.

plaintiffCases.description: Of cases, those on the plaintiff side.

title: Search attorneys
